Ducks at Golden Knights projected lineups

away.summary: The Golden Knights are projected to start Adin Hill in goal, marking his first start of the season. The lineup is expected to be unchanged from their 4-3 loss to the Anaheim Ducks on Friday, with Hill replacing Carter Hart as the only change. Dylan Coghlan and Raphael Lavoie are scratched, and there are no reported injuries.

home.summary: The Canucks are projected to start Kevin Lankinen in goal after Leevi Merilainen's first start. Jake DeBrusk is day-to-day with illness and will miss a second straight game, while Thatcher Demko (hip) and Filip Chytil (shoulder) are injured. Guillaume Brisebois and Victor Mancini are scratched. The team did not hold a morning skate after their 4-1 win over the Calgary Flames on Saturday.
